notes.title: These 9 PS Plus games are leaving the game catalogue forever in March
notes.notes:
Nine games are leaving PS Plus this month, never to return to the service again! As such, if you've got a PS Plus Extra subscription, you should redeem these games as soon as possible, before they're taken away.

A combination of both PS4 and PS5 games, these titles are downloadable and playable on both of these consoles only. If you own either of these, then you're good to go.

notes.title: Beat the Override 2 Devs and Win a Prize in This Weekend's Contest!
notes.notes:
This weekend, get ready to put metal to metal and compete to win prizes by queueing in up Override 2: Super Mech League to take on the developers of the game. To celebrate the free weekend on Steam and Xbox, members of the Modus Studios Brazil and Modus Games team will be matchmaking with random users in the Override 2 community. If you are able to best them in battle, you can win a free deck of Override 2 trading cards!

Here's how it works:

[list]
[*] Any time between Thursday, April 29 and Sunday, May 2, queue up for a match in Override 2: Super Mech League. 
[*] Look for the following usernames from members of the MSB and Modus Games team: Kaelliam, Hoagie, NPC, Bisco, aG.Hill, gabriel.cataldi, Vyeung76, Aragatti, Smoke_Max
[*] If you compete against and defeat one of the above users, screenshot the post-match screen and post it to Twitter or Instagram with #BeatTheO2Devs and then follow Modus_Games on the platform you've shared it on (so that we can reach out via DM!).
[/list]

We will randomly select 20 winners who share their screenshots by Sunday, May 2 at 11:59pm PDT. Winners will be announced Monday, May 3! Winners must respond within 48 hours of the initial message and verify their mailing address. [url=https://modusgames.com/news/beat-the-override-2-devs-and-win-a-prize-in-this-weekends-contest/]Click here for full rules and conditions. [/url]

notes.title: Dan Moroboshi Enters the Brawl in Override 2 Today!
notes.notes:
Dan Moroboshi joins the fray in Override 2: Super Mech League today. Enemies will cower in fear as he tears through them in his Ultraman Suit 7. Check out the new gameplay trailer for a look at the newest opponent that will be blasting through all mechs (and Kaijus) standing in his way:  

https://youtu.be/99mGM5Qd9hE

Dan Moroboshi follows Black King, Bemular and Ultraman himself as the fourth and final member of the ULTRAMAN crew joining the fight. 

The latest patch also introduces a few balance changes and additional quality of life improvements. You can check out the full list of updates here: https://modusgames.com/news/keep-up-with-the-latest-override-2-patches-here/ 

Override 2: Super Mech League gathers a crew of distinctly devastating mechs for electrifying, over-the-top throwdowns for 1-4 players. Action is accessible to all and easy to jump into, but strategic depth in combat design means even the most skill-focused players will find a deeply rewarding, eSports-ready challenge.

notes.title: Black King Smashes His Way into the Override 2, Cross-Platform Matchmaking Added
notes.notes:
Override’s very first playable kaiju makes his debut as a part of the ULTRAMAN DLC today! Black King brings a bevy of slashing, stomping, and chomping attacks to the arena giving him an arsenal of powerful melee attacks. Check out the brand-new gameplay trailer to see him action: 

https://youtu.be/3g9VmZ2le0A

Black King is a ravenous Kaiju from the ULTRAMAN anime with the power to rip enemies to shreds with ease. The character follows Ultraman and Bemular as the third of four ULTRAMAN characters coming to the game, with Dan Moroboshi releasing in the coming months. 

The new patch also adds cross-play matchmaking functionality to the game for Steam, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One users. This allows players on different platforms to experience improved queue times and battle against a larger competitive pool of participants for each map type. You can read the patch notes here:  https://modusgames.com/news/keep-up-with-the-latest-override-2-patches-here/  

Want to jump into the action? Override 2 is available now on Steam! Join the League today: www.override2.com

notes.title: Bemular Joins Override 2: Super Mech League Today
notes.notes:
Devastate your opponents with earth-shattering combos as Bemular, now available in Override 2: Super Mech League. Check out his reveal trailer below!  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=limxzEUcjc8&feature=youtu.be

Based on his appearance from the Netflix anime series, Bemular’s strange alien origins give him access to deadly energy attacks that will leave his opponents scrambling to keep up. His kit allows him to threaten enemies from any position in the arena, with powerful ranged attacks.  

[h2]Bemular’s Move Set: [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Triple Shot: [/b]Shoots three projectiles at Bemular’s target. Can be used while in the air.  
[*] [b]Beam Orb:[/b] Summons a ray-shooting orb that fires down from above.  
[*] [b]Piercing Ray:[/b] Shoots a ray that pierces enemies. Can be charged to fire an even stronger ray that knocks enemies down. Can be used while in the air.  
[*] [b]Explosion: [/b]Causes an explosion around Bemular. Avoids stuns for one hit during this attack.  
[*] [b]Ultimate:[/b] Charges an enormous energy ball and throws it at a target. Does more damage the longer it flies, up to twice its base damage.  
[/list]

Bemular follows Ultraman himself as the second of four ULTRAMAN characters coming to the game, with Black King and Dan Moroboshi releasing in the coming months.  

This new mech isn’t the only change coming to Override 2 today. The patch also includes a few additional updates and balancing tweaks, including the brand-new additions of co-op matchmaking (up to 2 players) in Leagues and Quick Play modes across all platforms. You can read the [url=https://modusgames.com/news/keep-up-with-the-latest-override-2-patches-here/]full patch notes here[/url]! 

[h2]Play as Bemular in Override 2: Super Mech League Now![/h2]

If you haven’t already, join in the unstoppable action by purchasing Override 2: Super Mech League now: www.override2.com. A free trial is also available, which allows players to try the game with a limited set of characters (Watchbot, Maya, Setesh) and grants access to the following modes: Quickplay, Versus, and a portion of Leagues.

notes.title: Our Very First Override 2 Community Tournament!
notes.notes:
Join us this afternoon, December 23rd at 3pm PT for our very first community tournament! 8 participants will compete for a chance to win prizes and the ultimate bragging rights of being the first community champion! 

The tournament will be double elimination with best of three matches until the grand final which will be best of 5! 

Watch it live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modus_games]twitch.tv/modus_games[/url] for a chance to win a copy of Override 2: Super Mech League on your platform of choice!

notes.title: Override 2 is now available! Enter the Arena Now!
notes.notes:
Climb the ranks in the all-new Leagues mode, or compete against friends online for the ultimate bragging rights in Override 2: Super Mech League, now available! 

In tandem with today’s release, the game’s official launch trailer came crashing onto the scene, giving soon-to-be mech-wielders a look at some of the heart-pounding, blistering combat they’ll be getting into. Get a sense of the action here: https://youtu.be/5ORAxb516ro

Override 2: Super Mech League - ULTRAMAN Deluxe Edition includes four fighters from the ULTRAMAN series as part of the season pass, along with additional bonuses. Ultraman can also be purchased separately for $3.99 starting today, and the ULTRAMAN Season Pass, containing access to Ultraman along with the future characters Bemular, Black King and Dan Moroboshi is $14.99. 

Override 2: Super Mech League gathers 20 distinctly devastating mechs for electrifying, over-the-top throwdowns for 1-4 players. Action is accessible to all and easy to jump into, but strategic depth in combat design means even the most skill-focused players will find a deeply rewarding, esports-ready challenge. See if you have what it takes to rise to the top in the ‘Leagues’ career mode, or take on friendly multiplayer matches as you begin to hone your skills.

notes.title: Introducing Leagues, Override 2’s All-New Career Mode
notes.notes:
Get your first look at Leagues, our all-new career mode coming to Override 2 on December 22! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QVj88U4tl6k&feature=youtu.be

In leagues, aspiring champions can join clubs and establish their reputation as they bash their way to the top of the competition. Check out the trailer to see the rewards awaiting mech pilots willing to fight. Joining a club in the league and earning well-fought victories will net sponsorship deals and unlockable cosmetics in the garage. Players can truly make mechs their own, outfitting them with unique skins and attachments to make their style as unforgettable as their in-ring performances.  

Override 2: Super Mech League gathers 20 distinctly devastating mechs for electrifying, over-the-top throwdowns for 1-4 players. Action is accessible to all and easy to jump into, but strategic depth in combat design means even the most skill-focused players will find a deeply rewarding, eSports-ready challenge as they grapple with rivals across dangerous arenas and a range of different game modes. 

Override 2: Super Mech League’s standard edition will be available digitally Dec. 22. Override 2: Super Mech League - ULTRAMAN Deluxe Edition will include four additional fighters from the iconic superhero series ULTRAMAN within the game’s season pass, along with bonus cosmetics.

notes.title: Get Your First Glimpse of Ultraman in Action in the Latest Override 2 Trailer
notes.notes:
Ultraman is entering the fray in Override 2: Super Mech League, and you can catch him in action in our newest gameplay trailer that just debuted at the Golden Joystick Awards presented by GamesRadar. Check out the brand new trailer here:  

https://youtu.be/-PaoIHqoDhc

Ultraman will be available alongside Bemular, Black King, and Dan Moroboshi in Override 2: Super Mech League – ULTRAMAN Edition releasing on December 22! The ULTRAMAN Edition includes the base game, all four ULTRAMAN characters, and bonus cosmetics!  

Wishlist on Steam! To learn more, visit the official [url=https://modusgames.com/override-2-super-mech-league/]Override 2 website[/url]!

notes.title: Brawl in the Override 2 Open Beta Available Now!
notes.notes:
Override 2: Super Mech League’s Open Beta is available now! Be the first to brawl with a selection of characters from our 20 mech roster across multiple games modes. Experience each fighters’ distinctively deadly abilities and stylish combos in the all-new, faster gameplay! The beta will run from November 16, 6am PT to November 22, 9pm PT.
https://youtu.be/oH2NmGkc_Uo
Game Modes:
[list]
[*] Versus: Invite your friends and face-off in local or online matches of up to 4 players in free-for-all or team battles.
[*] Online Multiplayer: Random queue of several modes-1v1, 2v2, 4-player free-for-all, and King of the Hill (at launch, players will be able to queue for all modes separately).
[*] Training: Practice your piloting skills in the arena solo or against AI opponents.
[*] Tutorial: Learn the ropes, including controls for basic attacks, abilities, and mobility.
[/list]
Playable Mechs in the Beta:

Maya, Vintage, Setesh, Watchbot, Sprinkles, Aura, Pescado, Vidar

Override 2: Super Mech League releases on December 22, 2020! Wishlist it on Steam!
[url=https://discord.gg/modus]
Join our Discord[/url] and share your clips!

notes.title: Steam Game Festival - Developer Live Stream
notes.notes: Join Modus Producer Bruce Hayles and Modus Community Manager Luke Croft as they face off in the newly available Override 2 demo. They will discuss the updated gameplay, new arenas, and show off the two returning mechs newly available in the demo, Vintage and Setesh! Watch it right here on Steam.

notes.title: New Demo Available for Steam Games Festival Adds Two Returning Mechs
notes.notes:
Last week, we ran our first closed beta test for Override 2: Super Mech League and got a lot of great feedback from our community! Now, to celebrate the Steam Games Festival: Autumn Edition, we are launching a public demo that will be available for the event, and it is available right now!  

In the demo you will be able to: 

[list]
[*] Play versus mode with friends in 1v1, 2v2, and free-for-all battles.  
[*] Jump into the matchmaking queue across the aforementioned game modes to test your skills against other players around the world.  
[*] Play as 7 available characters including the 5 featured in the closed beta, plus Setesh and Vintage for the first time!  
[/list]

Download the demo now and play it until the Steam Games Festival: Autumn Edition ends on October 13!   

Join us Thursday, October 8th at 12:30 PM PT for a developer live stream with Modus Producer Bruce Hayles and Modus Community Manager Luke Croft, as they show off gameplay and talk about Setesh and Vintage.

notes.title: Override 2 Closed Beta Starts This Weekend!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to be among the first to brawl in Override 2: Super Mech League? Codes for the closed beta on Steam are being sent out now. If you signed up to be a part of the open beta and live in US, Canada, UK, or Brazil, keep one eye on your inbox for your exclusive access code! 

https://youtu.be/7UVumRXVIIU

The beta will run from Friday, October 2 at 9am PT to Sunday, October 4 at 9pm PT! During this time, players will be able to test out 5 of the game’s 20 available towering mechs in a variety of randomly rotating modes, including 1v1, 2v2, Free-for-All, and King of the Hill. You can also invite up to three other players to compete against one another!

notes.title: ULTRAMAN comes to Override 2 in Override 2: ULTRAMAN Deluxe Edition
notes.notes:
At Opening Night Live, we teased a crossover announcement we would announce at a later date. Today, we are excited to finally reveal that ULTRAMAN will be coming to Override 2 in Override 2: ULTRAMAN Deluxe Edition! Check out the reveal trailer below:

https://youtu.be/Hemu8miyCbs

This oversized offering includes:

The Override 2: Super Mech League game
The ULTRAMAN Season Pass bringing four iconic fighters from Netflix’s ULTRAMAN series to Override 2
Additional ULTRAMAN cosmetic items for use in-game

Pre-orders are now available for $39.99 at retail ahead of a December 2020 launch on PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and Nintendo Switch. To celebrate this illustrious collaboration, consumers can save $5 on Amazon when pre-ordering.

Override 2: Super Mech League – ULTRAMAN Deluxe Edition will expand the game’s core 20-mech roster with four key characters from Netflix’s most-watched anime series of 2019: Shinjiro Hayata wearing the iconic ULTRAMAN Suit, the mysterious Bemular, Dan Moroboshi donning the ULTRAMAN Suit ver7, and the incredibly powerful alien Black King.

For all things Override 2: Super Mech League, jet over to the game’s official site where brawlers eager to throw the first punch can also sign up to join the game’s Steam beta.
